voice.text: A radio saved the Eiffel Tower. Then why could Paris legally demolish it? Eiffel's permit for his 1889 tower lasted only twenty years. In 1903, he let the army test radio from the top. Soon its signals crossed the Mediterranean. Turns out, the city then renewed his permit for seventy years.

caption:
A radio antenna saved the Eiffel Tower 📻

Eiffel's permit for his 1889 tower ran only twenty years, so from 1909 the City of Paris could take it down. In 1903 he let the army test radio from the top, and soon its signals crossed the Mediterranean. Too useful to lose: from 1910 the permit was renewed for seventy years.

Send this to the friend who loves a good comeback story.
